description: §42.4: an unresolved condition type is E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN — never silently accepted (S460 supersedes S440 Q2 for conditions).
rationale: §42.4 statement 5: "A condition whose value's type the compiler cannot resolve — … a call whose return type is neither declared nor inferred … SHALL be compile error **E-COND-NOT-BOOLEAN**." Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
